messages:
zara: FYI we just got an ACV signal from BigCo — they said competitor X has per-tenant routing + a simple compatibility flag and they're asking for the same. asking: can we scope something for the next sprint to avoid churn?
liam: can you paste the exact ask? parity can mean many things — is it UI, routing rules, or the model variant fallback?
arjun: sales said its mostly routing + an opt-in toggle that maps to competitor behavior. lightweight UX.
marta: exact quote from BigCo: "we need a per-tenant 'compat-mode' that falls back to their legacy tokens and routing for 95% of calls." they'll consider a reserved capacity commit if we can ship an opt-in beta in ~6 weeks.
liam: 6 weeks is tight. engineering concerns: per-tenant routing table + policy eval at request-time increases latency tail unless we batch policy checks. also extra telemetry and rollout gating.
zara: proposal idea: 1) implement a shim in the routing layer that supports a tenant-level flag (compat_mode) 2) default to existing routing but allow explicit tenant override 3) beta gated by canary + monitor for quality/regressions. launch criteria: - compat flag in API and console - < 5% p50 latency delta on average traffic - rollout plan + rollback tested - regression test set for top 10 prompts
arjun: +1 to shim approach. we can mock the console toggle and ship later. UX can be minimal (checkbox + docs).
sam: model-side note: if compat_mode changes model selection we need to validate tokenization/format differences. suggest a short eval harness: 500 prompt pairs across priority customers. also blocklist any prompts that trigger large quality drops.
liam: rough infra ETA: shim + flag handling + basic rollout = 3 weeks for eng work, +1 week for telemetry/QA, +1 week for docs/legal review = 5 weeks if we can prioritize. but that assumes no deep model rework.
marta: can we get a soft commitment from BigCo to be our first beta tenant? that would make the 5-week plan workable.
zara: action items: - liam: prototype shim and perf test (owner) - sam: eval harness & regression set (owner) - arjun: minimal console toggle + docs stub (owner) - marta: confirm beta tenant and negotiate MOU (owner) Please add to the sprint board.
deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled infra maintenance on 1743200000 may affect canary windows — plan around it.
liam: noted the maintenance window, well schedule canary after that.
zara: decision: proceed with shim + opt-in beta. well re-evaluate full parity backlog later (data/model ux). if anyone sees a hard blocker call it out now. :thumbsup:
arjun: no blockers from my side. syncing a 30m session tomorrow AM to align owners.
sam: will start eval runs tomorrow, posting preliminary results in this thread.
marta: will follow up with BigCo this afternoon. thanks all.
